operational_observations.source_category: Applications for an early vote by post
In-person early votes issued before polling day
Postal votes admitted for election-night counting

sources.notes: Formal vote-type counts come from the Legislative Assembly Types of Votes by District table. The 2025 ordinary category explicitly includes early in-person votes.

Later official election report reconstructing the completed pre-election early-voting operation. The in-person count is described as votes issued; at an issuing office this also represents ballots cast.
